notes: Major update since 3.11.16 (v3.11.17-3.11.27). Fixes several real-capture bugs: a slow flat-guard reset after a genuine stop, a rep-numbering desync after a spurious same-direction phase split, a velocity clamp that was corrupting the drift measurement instead of just the display, a discontinuity in the live velocity estimate right at a rep-calibration refit, an unbounded drift-rate extrapolation seeded by a single noisy short bracket, and a stuck correction offset after a deadlift's ground impact that could block genuine-stillness detection for several seconds. Adds serial START/STOP/CALIBRATE commands and automatic raw-log detection for the new desktop tool (tools/vbt_live_monitor.py), and fixes the status LED to reflect a serial-only connection. BLE PROTOCOL CHANGE: the Config characteristic shrank from 40 to 38 bytes (debugLogEnabled removed in 3.11.24, flatGuardOverrideStillTimeS removed and replaced by velocityOverrideFlatWindowSamples in 3.11.27) - update the companion app to at least 1.0.0+3 before writing Config against this firmware; older apps will have their Config writes silently ignored, everything else (streaming, rep summaries, start/stop/calibrate) keeps working.
